visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot focusing on multiple hands (belonging to several people) using small blue scissors to harvest ripe, bright red strawberries from green plants in an outdoor greenhouse. The lighting is bright and natural, casting distinct shadows on the leaves. (2) Medium shot of three young adults: a woman with pigtails in a plaid shirt and vest, a man in a light blue LOEWE hoodie, and another man in a black long-sleeved shirt. They are gathered closely in the aisle of the strawberry farm, laughing and reacting with high energy. (3) The man in the blue hoodie holds an exceptionally large and uniquely shaped strawberry toward the camera. He smiles widely while the woman beside him laughs. The background shows rows of elevated planting beds and green foliage stretching into the distance. (4) The woman with pigtails walks through the farm aisles, holding a basket and gesturing as if speaking to the camera. The camera follows her in a handheld motion. (5) The scene shifts to the exterior of a white modern building, then cuts to an interior living room area featuring a brown leather sofa, a bunch of blue and white balloons, and various decorative shelves. (6) A series of still photographs are displayed, showing close-ups of harvested strawberries and a final group photo of six people posing together in front of a white wall.
